# Introduction

This course covers the tools and technologies a geospatial professional needs for full stack development. We cover version control with Git, hosting and continuous deployment with GitHub, fundamentals of setting up cloud services, deploying applications with Docker and versioning spatial data with PostGIS and Kart.

# Installation and Preparation

## Sign up for GitHub

Visit [GitHub.com](https://github.com/){target="_blank"} and create a free account. If you already have an account, skip this step.

## Install Git and GitHub CLI

Follow our [Git and GitHub CLI Installation Guide](install-git-github.html){target="_blank"} to install and configure Git and GitHub CLI.
